phase2_governed_results.paired_interpretation: The paired evidence indicates lower peak maximum-HR behavior on FROM legs across complete TO→FNS/SNS→FROM outings. LP2-H0B rejected its null, while whole-ride average HR (LP2-H0A) and baseline-adjusted resting-relative HR (LP2-H0C) did not meet their null-rejection thresholds. This distinguishes transient upper response from sustained and baseline-adjusted ride state without assigning a mechanism.

temporal_decomposition.descriptive_attribution: The 2026 block has many more rides, a much larger FROM share, newly available vehicle subtypes and Kubios-linked source combinations, greater overnight representation, and higher readiness coverage. These composition shifts plausibly contribute to Phase-1 temporal heterogeneity; this is descriptive attribution because no confirmatory decomposition model or selected-breakpoint p-value was predeclared.

evidence_scope: Aggregate WHOOP and Strava longitudinal context; not a session-HRV substitution.
limitations: Sample counts, date coverage, source scope, missingness, and measurement availability accompany each scientific result.
